04 / GOOD QUESTIONS

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Still have something on your mind?

Ask Cre directly
What’s the difference between repair and optimization?

Credit repair focuses on identifying and disputing errors in your credit reports. Optimization looks at your wider credit profile and the habits that may support it, such as payment consistency and managing balances.

Can you guarantee a score increase?

No. Every credit profile is different. A specific score increase, approval, removal, or timeline cannot be guaranteed. Accurate, current negative information cannot simply be removed through credit repair.

How long does the process take?

Timing depends on your starting point, the information on your reports, and the steps involved. Cre can discuss your situation and what to expect before you decide to move forward.

How much does it cost to work with Cre?

Contact Cre for current service options and pricing. You’ll be able to review the scope, costs, and terms before deciding whether a service is right for you.

Can I work on my credit myself?

Yes. You can review your reports and dispute errors yourself at no charge. Professional guidance is optional. Learn more from the FTC’s credit repair guide.

What do I need to get started?

Just your name, email, and a general idea of your goals. Please don’t send Social Security numbers, account numbers, passwords, or credit reports through this form or email.
